favourite.heading: Why Texas A&M can pull away
bullets: Texas A&M is the better football team by 7.8 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 55% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (+7.8 pts).
Playing at Texas A&M is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).
Stylistically the matchup favours Texas A&M by 0.2 points: ball control vs front disruption (+0.2 pts).

underdog.heading: Why Arkansas can keep it close
bullets: Pass defense: Arkansas 52.1 (#54 of 137) vs Texas A&M 40.6 (#121 of 137) — 67 places on the national board.
Scheme fit: Arkansas 53.5 (#9 of 137) vs Texas A&M 50.5 (#65 of 137) — 56 places on the national board.

The outcome range is 14.8 points wide at one sigma — p10 -9.9 to p90 +32.1 for Texas A&M, so a projection of +12.1 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 1%.
